The '''Slayer Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked by defeating [[Slayer]] bosses and used to store their basic drops. It has {{Green|3}} sizes, each increasing the number of items it can hold. The different sizes are unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Zombie Slayer 2}}, {{CollectionLink|Spider Slayer 3}}, and {{CollectionLink|Wolf Slayer 2}}. The '''Small Slayer Sack''' can hold {{Green|2,240}} of each item, the '''Medium Slayer Sack''' can hold {{Green|6,720}} of each item, and the '''Large Slayer Sack''' can hold {{Green|20,160}} of each item.
